facts.fact: Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel Group converted their December 2024 memorandum into a binding agreement for the Horizon Fiber cross-border terrestrial corridor from Djibouti through Ethiopia to Sudan; the document gives no signing date, so its published date is used.
The three operators signed the Horizon Fiber memorandum of understanding in December 2024.

systems.owner: Djibouti Telecom, Ethio Telecom, Sudatel Group
